extraction.tool: extract_parcels.py (this directory; never imported or run by tests)
extraction.credentials: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY from environment only; no connection string, key, or internal URL appears in this directory (operator ruling, 2026-08-01)

privacy_ruling_R1: All personal and entity names in these fixtures appear VERBATIM as they appear in the cited public records (Cook County Assessor sales mirror, Assessor parcel universe, Treasurer 2022 Annual Tax Sale results). No mailing-address fields were extracted (taxpayer_m and mailing_* dropped). Where records name different parties for one parcel, that is a statement that RECORDS DISAGREE and requires verification against the underlying instruments; nothing in these fixtures or the belief objects built from them characterizes, accuses, or draws conclusions about any person or entity.

deeds.json.source_table: cook_assessor_sales (operator warehouse mirror of Cook County Assessor - Parcel Sales)
deeds.json.event_observed_date: each deed row's own sale_date (the record's date)
deeds.json.chain: public dataset -> warehouse ingest (ingested_at kept per row) -> extraction 2026-08-01
deeds.json.note: For PIN 29024080530000 the same six sale rows exist in pilot/snapshots/ccao_parcel_sales.json (M-RI-11, retrieved 2026-07-27) — two independent mirrors of the same public rows.

assessor_owners.json.source_table: cook_assessor_parcel (operator warehouse mirror of the CCAO parcel universe)
assessor_owners.json.event_observed_date: each row's warehouse ingested_at date (taxpayer of record as of ingest)

tax_sale_forfeitures.json.redactions: taxpayer_m (mailing address) and geometry dropped per privacy ruling R1; all other properties verbatim
